description: FILE STATUS '37' ON THE XREFFILE SEQUENTIAL READ takes WHEN OTHER of the EVALUATE at app/cbl/CBSTM03A.CBL:L353-L362 - the guard this program's file-status convention is stated in - so the run abends after all four inputs are open and the transaction table is loaded, and before a single statement is composed. 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT sets the call up exactly as the source does - MOVE 'XREFFILE' TO WS-M03B-DD (:347), SET M03B-READ TO TRUE (:348), MOVE ZERO TO WS-M03B-RC (:349), MOVE SPACES TO WS-M03B-FLDT (:350) - and CALL 'CBSTM03B' USING WS-M03B-AREA (:351) reports '37'. That is neither the '00' of :354, which CONTINUEs, nor the '10' of :356, which MOVEs 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE, so the third arm runs: DISPLAY 'ERROR READING XREFFILE' (:359), DISPLAY 'RETURN CODE: ' WS-M03B-RC (:360), PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM (:361). THE THREE ARMS ARE ORDERED AND THE ORDER IS THE ASSERTION (gate G30): a guard rewritten as 'anything that is not 00 is end of file' would set END-OF-FILE to 'Y' here, leave 1000-MAINLINE's PERFORM UNTIL quietly, close four files and report zero - a clean run that produced no statement and no diagnostic. This case is what makes that indistinguishable-looking mistake fail. UNIT AND INVOCATION: statement.StatementGenerationJobA as a BATCH_JOB, reached at step/Tasklet level with statement.StatementGenerationJobB as its constructor-injected collaborator - no JobLauncher, no job repository and no HTTP anywhere in the path (gate G51). jobParameters is empty because no step of app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL declares a PARM, STEP040 at line 79 being EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A,COND=(0,NE) and nothing more. The '37' itself is supplied by this case's declared scenario at the READ_XREFFILE call site rather than by a seeded record, because a file status is a property of the environment and not of any row: no cross-reference record can be written that makes a healthy read report '37'. WHAT HAS ALREADY HAPPENED, AND WHY THAT MATTERS: the TIOT walk at :266-:291 has run, OPEN OUTPUT STMT-FILE HTML-FILE at :293 has opened BOTH outputs, INITIALIZE WS-TRNX-TABLE WS-TRN-TBL-CNTR at :294 has cleared the table, and the ALTER-driven chain at 0000-START (:298-:314) has opened all four inputs in its own order - 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN (:730) with its own first read at :746 and the 8500-READTRNX-READ load loop (:818-:853), then 8200-XREFFILE-OPEN (:765), 8300-CUSTFILE-OPEN (:783) and 8400-ACCTFILE-OPEN (:801), whose GO TO 1000-MAINLINE at :815 enters the loop. The failure is therefore at the FIRST cross-reference read of an otherwise healthy run, which is what pins it to the read guard rather than to an open guard: case12 owns the TRNXFILE open guard at :736-:742 and case16 owns the close guard at :862-:868. Nothing downstream runs - 2000-CUSTFILE-GET (:321) and 3000-ACCTFILE-GET (:322) are never performed, the four closes at :331-:337 and CLOSE STMT-FILE HTML-FILE at :339 are never reached, and 9999-GOBACK at :341 is never arrived at. THE SEVENTEEN LINE TEMPLATES ARE THE THING THAT MUST NOT APPEAR, AND THIS IS WHERE THAT IS ASSERTED (gate G21): 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT opens with INITIALIZE STATEMENT-LINES (:459) and WRITE FD-STMTFILE-REC FROM ST-LINE0 (:460), and it is performed only from :323 - inside the IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' at :320, which the WHEN OTHER arm never reaches because it abends inside :319's PERFORM. So not one byte of 01 STATEMENT-LINES (:85-:146) may reach either sink on this path. That group is SEVENTEEN 05-level items - ST-LINE0 through ST-LINE15 plus ST-LINE14A - and every one sums to exactly 80 by addition of its PICTURE widths (practice B11, gates G19 and G21): ST-LINE0 31+18+31; ST-LINE1 75+5; ST-LINE2 and ST-LINE3 50+30; ST-LINE4 80; ST-LINE5, ST-LINE10 and ST-LINE12 a single X(80) each; ST-LINE6 33+14+33; ST-LINE7 and ST-LINE9 20+20+40; ST-LINE8 20+13+7+40, its two trailing SPACES items X(07) and X(40) being separate declarations at :114 and :115; ST-LINE11 30+20+30; ST-LINE13 16+51+13; ST-LINE14 16+1+49+1+13; ST-LINE14A 10+56+1+13; ST-LINE15 32+16+32. INITIALIZE'S SCOPE IS NARROWER THAN IT LOOKS, AND IT IS PRESERVED (practice B5): INITIALIZE without REPLACING resets only the ELEVEN NAMED elementary items - ST-NAME X(75), ST-ADD1 X(50), ST-ADD2 X(50), ST-ADD3 X(80), ST-ACCT-ID X(20), ST-CURR-BAL 9(9).99-, ST-FICO-SCORE X(20), ST-TRANID X(16), ST-TRANDT X(49), ST-TRANAMT Z(9).99- and ST-TOTAL-TRAMT Z(9).99- - each to its own category's image: an alphanumeric slot to spaces across its declared width; ST-CURR-BAL to 000000000.00 followed by the blank positive sign position, because 9(9) is NOT zero-suppressed; and the two Z(9).99- slots to nine spaces, then .00, then a blank sign position, because Z(9) IS - thirteen bytes each, and neither is all-blank, since no BLANK WHEN ZERO is declared anywhere in the group. Every other byte of the group is an elementary FILLER carrying a VALUE, and INITIALIZE does not touch it: the ALL '*' banners of ST-LINE0 and ST-LINE15, the three ALL '-' eighty-character rules ST-LINE5, ST-LINE10 and ST-LINE12 - byte-identical, and told apart by POSITION and never by content - 'Basic Details', 'TRANSACTION SUMMARY ', the three colon labels 'Account ID         :', 'Current Balance    :' and 'FICO Score         :' with their interior space runs intact, the 'Tran ID         ' and 'Tran Details    ' and '  Tran Amount' headings, the two '$' signs at :136 and :141, 'Total EXP:' and every declared run of SPACES. A translation that read INITIALIZE as 'blank the eighty-byte area' would still emit 80-byte records, so only a byte-level comparison catches it - and a translation that composed or pre-blanked a line BEFORE the read guard, or that emitted a banner on the abend path, produces a record HERE where the COBOL produces none. That is what expectedDatasets turns into an assertion rather than an absence: STMTFILE rowCount 0 at recordLength 80 and HTMLFILE rowCount 0 at recordLength 100, on the WRITES channel and again on FINAL_STATE. BOTH CHANNELS ARE ASSERTED, AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME CLAIM: WRITES says the program wrote nothing to datasets it had already opened at :293; FINAL_STATE says nothing survived the run. Here they agree at zero for two independent reasons - nothing was written, and app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL:L87-L96 declares both outputs DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE), so a run that does not reach :339 leaves neither dataset behind however many records it wrote. case16, which abends at the close AFTER a complete statement, is where the two channels visibly disagree; naming both here is what stops a row count of zero from being read as no expectation at all. WIDTHS COME FROM TWO SOURCES EACH, AND ARE ASSERTED EVEN THOUGH NO ROW EXISTS: STMTFILE is 80 bytes, from 01 FD-STMTFILE-REC PIC X(80) (:45) and from CREASTMT.JCL LINE 89, DCB=(LRECL=80,BLKSIZE=8000,RECFM=FB), under the STMTFILE DD at line 87. Line 90 of that JCL is genuinely corrupted - verbatim '//         SPACE=(CYL,(1,1),RLSE), 00,RECFM=FB), ATA.VSAM.KSDS', a text-overlay artefact splicing fragments of other lines - and its ' 00,RECFM=FB)' remnant sits directly beneath STMTFILE where it is easily misread as LRECL=100. Line 89 is authoritative, and the JCL is left exactly as it stands: it is the parity oracle, so the hazard is recorded and worked around here rather than corrected there (practice B4; app/cbl, app/cpy, app/jcl and app/data are read-only throughout, practice B3). HTMLFILE is 100 bytes, from 01 FD-HTMLFILE-REC PIC X(100) (:47) and from line 94, DCB=(LRECL=100,BLKSIZE=800,RECFM=FB), which supersedes STEP030's pre-delete LRECL=80,BLKSIZE=3200 at line 69 because the step that creates the dataset wins (gate G20, risk R-G). Stating recordLength is the only way to pin the identity of a dataset expected to be empty, which is exactly the situation on both channels here. SEEDS ARE REAL BYTES, AND THE INPUT IS PRESENT SO THAT ITS ABSENCE CANNOT BE THE EXPLANATION: XREFFILE is row 0 of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt verbatim - XREF-CARD-NUM 0500024453765740, XREF-CUST-ID 000000050, XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000050 - a row the read WOULD have returned, so the abend is caused by the status and not by an empty file; the empty-cross-reference path is case10's subject and it ends in RETURN-CODE 0, not 8. The row stays 36 bytes here. ParityCase.Normalisation is the sole owner of the 14-space pad up to CVACT03Y's declared 50 - XREF-CARD-NUM X(16) + XREF-CUST-ID 9(09) + XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11) + FILLER X(14) - and applies it once, at seed time, through the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50, so the fixture is never edited and the pad is never double-applied (gates G16 and G21). ACCTFILE and CUSTFILE are acctdata.txt (300 x 50) and custdata.txt (500 x 50) whole; both are open and neither is read, because 2000-CUSTFILE-GET and 3000-ACCTFILE-GET follow the failed read. Had they been reached, the keys would have been XREF-CUST-ID at LENGTH OF 9 (:374) and XREF-ACCT-ID at LENGTH OF 11 (:398), and the customer would have arrived through CUSTREC, whose date of birth is CUST-DOB-YYYYMMDD and never CVCUS01Y's CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD. TRNXFILE IS INLINE BECAUSE THERE IS NO TENTH FIXTURE: app/data/ASCII holds exactly nine .txt files and none of them is a statement transaction file, so the single row is composed from app/cpy/COSTM01.CPY at exactly 350 bytes - TRNX-CARD-NUM X(16) plus TRNX-ID X(16) as the 32-byte composite key that DELDEF01's IDCAMS corroborates with KEYS(32 0) at line 30 and RECORDSIZE(350 350) at line 32, then TRNX-REST as 2+4+10+100+11+9+50+50+10+26+26 = 298 plus a trailing FILLER X(20) emitted as spaces = 318. Span by span it is TRNX-TYPE-CD '01', TRNX-CAT-CD '0001', TRNX-SOURCE 'POS TERM  ', TRNX-DESC 'Table loaded, never used' padded to 100, TRNX-AMT '0000000010{' - an 11-byte zoned S9(09)V99 closing on the '{' overpunch, which encodes a positive digit zero, so 1.00 - TRNX-MERCHANT-ID '000000001', TRNX-MERCHANT-NAME 'Blick-Rippin' padded to 50, TRNX-MERCHANT-CITY 'Port Renayfurt' padded to 50, TRNX-MERCHANT-ZIP '60176     ', and the two X(26) timestamps. Its TRNX-CARD-NUM equals the cross-reference card, and rows are ordered ascending by card then id, the order STEP010's SORT FIELDS=(263,16,CH,A,1,16,CH,A) at line 53 produces. THE ROW REALLY IS LOADED: 8100-TRNXFILE-OPEN's read at :746 takes it, MOVE TRNX-CARD-NUM TO WS-SAVE-CARD (:757), MOVE 1 TO CR-CNT (:758) and MOVE 0 TO TR-CNT (:759) precede the load loop, and 8500-READTRNX-READ places it at the 1-based WS-CARD-NUM(1), WS-TRAN-NUM(1,1) and WS-TRAN-REST(1,1) (:827-:829) before its next read reports '10' and 8599-EXIT sets WS-TRCT(1) (:850) - and it is never used, because ADD TRNX-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-AMT (:429) lives in 4000-TRNXFILE-GET, which :326 reaches only after a statement has been composed. Its TRNX-DESC span says so in its own bytes. MESSAGES, DERIVED LINE BY LINE: twelve DISPLAY_LINE expectations in emission order. 'Running JCL : ' TIOTNJOB ' Step ' TIOTJSTP (:270), with TIOTNJOB 'CREASTMT' and TIOTJSTP 'STEP040 ' - eight bytes each, so that closing blank is the field's own and not decoration. 'DD Names from TIOT: ' (:275). Then one ': ' TIOCDDNM ' -- valid UCB' (:279) for each of STEP040's six dataset DDs in JCL declaration order - TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, ACCTFILE, CUSTFILE, STMTFILE, HTMLFILE (lines 83-92; STEPLIB, SYSPRINT and SYSOUT at lines 80-82 are not data allocations, and ACCTFILE precedes CUSTFILE because the JCL declares it first). Then the post-loop entry at :290, whose ' -- null  UCB' carries TWO spaces after null and is byte-different from the in-loop ' --  null UCB' at :281, with TIOCDDNM X(08) blank. Then the guard's own two lines, 'ERROR READING XREFFILE' (:359) and 'RETURN CODE: 37' (:360) - the second being the literal 'RETURN CODE: ' followed by WS-M03B-RC PIC X(02), so exactly two characters with no padding. Then 'ABENDING PROGRAM' (:922). RETURN CODE AND ABEND: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM is that DISPLAY followed by a bare CALL 'CEE3ABD' (:923) - no USING, no ABCODE and no TIMING, the only such site in the estate (gate G35) - and expectedReturnCode is 8, the code the ten guarded sites abend with. It is stated explicitly because the member is boxed: an omitted key is refused rather than defaulted to 0, so a case that forgot it cannot pass itself off as a clean run. DETERMINISM: nothing here is read from a clock. The program composes no timestamp of its own, and TRNX-ORIG-TS and TRNX-PROC-TS are inert seed bytes carrying the fixed 2022-07-18 12:00:00.000000 literal the shipped transaction data uses - which this path never renders - so no expected value can move between runs (practice B7). Bytes are US-ASCII throughout, matching app/data/ASCII, and never a platform default (practice B8). PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the CBSTM03A and CBSTM03B paragraphs, cross-checked against the COSTM01, CVACT03Y, CUSTREC and CVACT01Y byte layouts, the CREASTMT.JCL DD and DCB contracts and the real ASCII fixtures. It was never captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and app/cpy/CUSTREC.cpy carries literal TAB characters that break parsing outright (practice B12).
